title: The Blind Man in Bethsaida
description: People bring a blind man to Jesus in Bethsaida and ask him to touch the man. Jesus takes the man by the hand, leads him out of the village, spits on his eyes, and lays his hands on him. When asked if he sees anything, the man answers: "I see people; they look like walking trees." Jesus then lays his hands on the man's eyes again, and his sight is restored so that he sees everything clearly. Finally, Jesus sends him home with instructions not to go back into the village.
